summaries.wework-devops: DevOps Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Terraform, CI/CD automation, AWS/GCP cloud management, and security/compliance for cloud infrastructure. Owned release engineering and CI/CD automation for four open-source cloud-infrastructure products at Turbot HQ (9,300+ GitHub stars, 120+ merged PRs), and authored multi-cloud compliance modules cutting enterprise audit time 50%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, automated Slack release notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging.

Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests (ephemeral environments across CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS) to the GitHub Actions release pipeline, hardening release safety and catching regressions before deployment.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS, Azure, GCP), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks; cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, deployment, and Terraform-driven integration testing; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework, containerized with Docker and deployed to AWS EC2.
